observations: Pinned epass2003 ATR table masks12..14 and18..22; EFY Calais mask is more specific at18..21.
OpenSC comments identify version triplets010011 and230025 in generic ePass2003 examples; they are not observed EFY models.
GET_DATA CA0186 selects FIPS/non-FIPS, AES/DES and optional plain-vs-SCP01 transport using response markers. These are SM capabilities, not issuer/PIN evidence.
epass2003_init calls refresh without checking its return value; explicit checked refresh + successful public reads is needed before trusting SM readiness.
Generic driver advertises multiple RSA sizes and EC256; current app ESPK resolver admits only RSA2048/e65537. Advertised algorithms are not card-personalization proof.
Legacy entersafe is a different driver with a different PIN path via ISO pin_cmd; ePass/Feitian branding is not enough to reuse EFY challenge-auth.
